lines.say: Starbucks once closed about seven thousand stores at the same time.
A hundred and thirty five thousand baristas went back to class.
They didn't buy ads. They fixed the experience for people already coming.
caps: They fixed it for *people already coming.*

lines.say: Regulars notice when it slips. They don't complain. They just stop coming.
Ask them. One text beats guessing why they left.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
